project.name: Inspecto — Scoring (optional)
project.description:
OPTIONAL add-on module (MODULE-REORG-1 P7, 2026-10-07): the Scoring half of the "Scoring and Lists" add-on of plan §8a (the Lists half is inspecto-entity-list). Risk Scores: the risk-score model and its evaluator (RiskScoreModel, RiskScorer, RiskScoreEvaluator), the risk.score Job Type (RiskScoreJobType), the read and preview routes (RiskScoreRoutes: GET /risk-scores/{model}/{entityKey}, POST /risk-scores/preview) and the save-time checks of the risk-score component kind and of the reserved risk_scores_ output stores (RiskScoreKindValidator). Package com.gamma.risk.
Contributed through the core's public seams only: com.gamma.control.RouteModule (feature id "scoring"), com.gamma.job.JobTypeProvider (risk.score) and com.gamma.control.ComponentKindValidator. It depends on inspecto-entity-list for one thing, the com.gamma.entitylist.WatchListFeed seam a model's watchList feeds through (the dependency direction is scoring to entity-list, never the reverse).
What stays in the core: the risk-score config component kind, the pending Alert Rule feature (PendingAlertRules, which reads only the naming facts of com.gamma.alert.RiskScoreOutputs), the risk.score.produced subscriber (by event-type string), the CapabilityManifest rows, the EvidenceMasker (com.gamma.mask) and AbsentModuleRoutes (503 stub).
Bundled from the Professional edition up (the Standard, Professional, Enterprise and Preview profiles) next to inspecto-entity-list; on Personal the core answers the /risk-scores paths with 503 "not installed", /bootstrap reports features.scoring=false and risk.score is an unknown Job Type. THIN: no shade, no sidecar classifier. Built only under the edition profiles, so a routine "mvn -o clean test" (= Personal) never compiles it.
